THIS PICTURE IS MADE OF TYPE. A 3D MODEL IS RENDERED, THEN A SHADER REDRAWS IT AS MONOSPACE BITMAP LETTERS IN PURE BLACK AND WHITE. BRIGHTNESS NEVER PICKS THE LETTER, ONLY ITS WEIGHT: BLANK, GREYED, REGULAR OR BOLD. LIT AREAS FLIP TO BLACK TYPE ON WHITE. THE TEXT MOVES TWO CHARACTERS A BEAT. LOUDER BARS USE SMALLER LETTERS. THE SNARE INVERTS THE FRAME. THE KICK FLASHES THE BIG WORD WHITE.

EVERY ROW IS ITS OWN TICKER. ALTERNATE ROWS RUN OPPOSITE WAYS. A ROW MOVES 2, 4 OR 6 CHARACTERS A BEAT. THE 3D MODEL IS NOT DRAWN: WHERE IT IS LIT, THE WALL OF TYPE TURNS TO INVERSE VIDEO. THIS IS 12 X 16 PIXEL MONOSPACE, THE SMALLEST SIZE USED HERE. THE SNARE FLIPS THE WHOLE WALL.
MACRO: EVERY FONT PIXEL IS DRAWN 2 OR 3 SCREEN PIXELS WIDE. LIGHT TURNS THE TYPE TO BLACK ON WHITE.

THE SAME SHADER WITH THE FRAME INVERTED: A WHITE PAGE OF BLACK TYPE. THREE 3D MODELS SEEN FROM ABOVE ARE REDRAWN AS BLOCKS OF MONOSPACE BITMAP TEXT. THEIR LIT SIDES PRINT BLACK, THE EMPTY SPACE AROUND THEM IS PAPER. THE PAGE IS TYPED IN FROM THE LEFT AT EACH CUT. THE SNARE TURNS IT BLACK.

NO 3D MODEL HERE. THIS CORRIDOR IS A FEW LINES OF SHADER MATHS: ONE DIVIDE GIVES DEPTH, THEN STRIPES BECOME CEILING TUBES, A CHECKER BECOMES CARPET AND RECTANGLES BECOME DOORS. THE RESULT IS A BRIGHTNESS MAP, REDRAWN AS MONOSPACE BITMAP TYPE. IT TRAVELS HALF A TUBE EVERY BEAT. THE KICK MAKES THE TUBES SURGE.

QUADTREE: THE FRAME STARTS AS 96 X 128 PIXEL LETTERS. A BLOCK SPLITS IN FOUR WHEREVER THE PICTURE INSIDE IT HAS CONTRAST, DOWN TO 12 X 16. FLAT AREAS KEEP HUGE LETTERS, EDGES GET TINY ONES. A KICK SPLITS MORE BLOCKS.

ONE RENDER OF A 3D MODEL, REPEATED AS A GRID OF 3 TO 5 TILES A SIDE. EVERY OTHER COLUMN IS MIRRORED. EVERY OTHER TILE IS DRAWN IN NEGATIVE, AND THAT CHECKER SWAPS ON EACH BEAT. THE LETTERS ARE NOT TILED: ONE PAGE OF 12 PIXEL TYPE RUNS ACROSS ALL OF THEM.

THE BIG WORD IS A WINDOW. THE PAGE OF TYPE EXISTS ONLY INSIDE ITS LETTERS. THE 3D MODEL IS A BLACK HOLE IN THAT PAGE, WITH A WHITE OUTLINE THAT CARRIES ON OUTSIDE THE WORD. KICKS AND BEATS FILL THE DARK AROUND IT WITH GREYED TYPE FOR A MOMENT.

THIS IS ANOTHER SCENE'S PICTURE, REDRAWN AS TYPE. ITS BRIGHTNESS IS CUT TO PURE BLACK AND WHITE AND EVERY CELL BECOMES A MONOSPACE BITMAP LETTER. BRIGHTNESS NEVER PICKS THE LETTER, ONLY ITS WEIGHT: BLANK, GREYED, REGULAR OR BOLD. THE TEXT MOVES TWO CHARACTERS A BEAT. THE SNARE INVERTS THE FRAME.
